title: Pneumatic Post letter, version 1
description: One letter per file under content/letters/ (work order 015, scope 2; GDD section 5, The Pneumatic Post). A letter is a short storylet: every storylet/1 field with the same meaning, but 1 or 2 options, plus 'sender' (free text; there is no character registry to check it against) and 'weight', its deck weight, a number greater than 0 (the GDD gives no scale). 'id' is act.location.name: act is 'prologue' for act 0, else act1 to act3, and must agree with 'act'; location must equal 'location' (the schema check's id-form rule). 'act' is 0 for the Prologue, then 1 to 3. 'reveal_layer' is 0 (no reveal) to 3; the reveal check holds it at or below 'act'. 'requires' maps a quality name to a condition string: one of >=, <=, ==, >, < followed by a whole number, e.g. ">=30" (the GDD example's form); an empty object means no requirement. Each option has a 'label', an optional 'requires', and either a certain outcome, written 'success' alone as in the GDD example, or a 'challenge' {quality, difficulty} with both 'success' and 'failure'. Each outcome is {text, changes}: 'changes' maps a quality name to either a signed string "+N" or "-N" (adjust by N) or a non-negative integer (set to it), as in the GDD example. Whether each named quality exists is the qualities check's job; reachability is the story_graph check's; word limits and banned words are the style check's. 'revision' is optional and exists only so a register row's revision can match the file.
